Below are two *SEARCH/REPLACE* patches for src/languages/bash.js. The first injects new operator, redirection and continuation‐line tokens right after the existing `SUBST.contains.push(QUOTE_STRING);`. The second adds these new tokens (along with `SUBST`) into the main `contains` array so that pipes (`|`), redirections (`<`, `>` , `<<`, `<<<`), continuation backslashes (`\` at end of line) and `$(…)` are actually highlighted.

Explanation of the additions:

- REDIRECTION  
  Highlights stream redirections: `<`, `>`, `<<`, `>>`, `<<<`.
- OPERATOR  
  Highlights pipe (`|`), boolean ops (`&&`, `||`), semicolons, etc.
- CONTINUATION  
  Highlights a backslash at end of line (`\`), i.e. the line‐continuation marker.
- SUBST  
  Was already defined but was never added to the top‐level `contains`, so now `$(…)` forms are highlighted.
- We left the original `VAR` rule unchanged so that `$var` and `${var}` still work.
